en_title: Bethesda Is Already Selling The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel Merch
cn_title: 贝塞斯达已经开始销售《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》周边
opus_summary: 贝塞斯达在公布《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》的完整名称后，已在网店上架印有游戏标志的连帽衫和T恤，售价分别为64.99美元(约合人民币433元)和34.99美元(约合人民币233元)，均为黑色。游戏预计至少还要几年才会发售。

paragraphs.en: Hot on the heels of Bethesda Game Studios officially announcing the full name of its highly anticipated next project, The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel, the developer has already put up merch for the upcoming RPG on its online shop. You can be the first person in your friend group with a Sentinel-logo hoodie or T-shirt. And like the Ford Model T, it comes in any color you want, as long as it's black.
paragraphs.cn: 就在贝塞斯达游戏工作室正式公布备受期待的下一个项目全名《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》后不久，这家开发商已经在其在线商店上架了这款即将推出的RPG周边。你可以成为朋友圈里第一个拥有印有Sentinel标志的连帽衫或T恤的人。就像Ford Model T一样，你可以选择任何你想要的颜色，只要它是黑色。

paragraphs.en: The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel hoodie is $64.99, while the identical item in T-shirt form is $34.99. Hat tip to @MrMattyPlays on X for first spotting the Sentinel merch. Bethesda says, "Celebrate The Elder Scrolls VI. Your next journey through Tamriel will be in The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel. Show off your excitement with the official hoodie!" And if you're interesteed in ordering, note the disclaimer: "This hoodie runs small. For the perfect fit, we recommend ordering one size larger than your usual size." The T-shirt shares an identical description, minus the note about it running small.
paragraphs.cn: 《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》连帽衫售价64.99美元，同款T恤售价34.99美元。感谢X上的@MrMattyPlays率先发现了Sentinel周边。贝塞斯达表示：「庆祝《上古卷轴6》。你在Tamriel的下一段旅程将在《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》中展开。穿上官方连帽衫，展现你的兴奋之情！」如果你有兴趣订购，请留意这条说明：「这款连帽衫尺码偏小。为了获得完美的合身效果，我们建议订购比你平时大一码的尺码。」T恤的描述完全相同，只是没有尺码偏小的提示。

paragraphs.en: You'll have plenty of time to break in either of these clothing items, as Sentinel isn't expected to be released for at least a couple more years . That would mean it might be at least a decade between the original announcement of The Elder Scrolls 6 and the time it's finally on your hard drive. Regardless, it's arguably the biggest game Xbox has in its portfolio by a country mile and when the release date finally arrives, it's going to be a very, very big deal.
paragraphs.cn: 你会有充足的时间把这两件衣服中的任何一件穿得合身，因为《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》预计至少还要再过几年才会推出。这意味着，从《上古卷轴6》最初公布到它最终出现在你的硬盘上，可能至少要间隔十年。无论如何，它可以说是XBOX游戏阵容中规模最大的游戏，远远超过其他作品；当发售日终于到来时，这将是一件非常、非常重大的事。

paragraphs.en: Amidst all of the changes at Xbox this year, it will be interesting to see if, a) The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel will be available on Xbox Game Pass Ultimate on day one, b) if it might line up with the launch of Xbox's next-gen Project Helix console/gaming PC hybrid , and/or c) if it ends up being an Xbox console exclusive .
paragraphs.cn: 在XBOX今年经历的种种变化之中，以下几点值得关注：a）《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》是否会首日登陆XBOX Game Pass Ultimate；b）它是否可能与XBOX下一代主机和游戏PC混合设备Project Helix同步推出；以及／或者c）它最终是否会成为XBOX主机独占游戏。

paragraphs.en: Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
paragraphs.cn: Ryan McCaffrey是IGN负责前瞻内容的执行编辑、IGN每周XBOX节目《Podcast Unlocked》的主持人，也是《Next-Gen Console Watch》的联合主持人。他是North Jersey人，所以那叫「Taylor ham」，不叫「pork roll」。可以在X上通过@DMC_Ryan和他辩论这个问题。
